_comment: Scenario-staged ROLL_THE_LINE demo: a full-strength (120) player Infantry unit is ordered under the roll-the-line stance to attack a lone weak (15-man, low-morale) enemy at the front of a line of three. As each enemy in turn breaks and routs, the attacker automatically rolls onto the next-closest enemy still fighting -- no fresh order issued for the second or third target. Camera holds on the line so the sequential engagement reads clearly.

facing_flutter.reason: Tracked in #1764, a sub-degree facing sawtooth (about 0.25 degrees, every 2-4 ticks) while uid 3 marches up behind uid 1. Measured 2026-10-09, merge-base 1f4a77eb against fix commit 392571fd (whose roll_the_line transcript is identical to 20bf172b's). Under CI's dense delta (2-tick samples from the divergence tick 61), the merge-base reads uid 3 at 2, below the threshold of 3, and the fix reads 7. So at that sampling the merge-base passes and only the fix fails. Two measurements attribute the sawtooth itself to code older than the fix. With every tick from 61 to 540 sampled, the merge-base fails too: uid 3 at 6 and uid 2 at 4 (the fix: 13 and 9). And a temporary exact-facing print measured the same amplitude on both trees (merge-base ticks 220-249, fix ticks 154-176). Uid 3 never reflects its grid. It differs only because uid 1, which bakes its re-square's mirror at tick 62, now keeps its men on their flanks, so uid 3 marches behind a differently shaped block. Uid 2 is the same #1764 sawtooth, marching up behind uid 1 for longer on this branch. Between ticks 40 and 60 uid 1 (15 men, IDLE, not routing: it routs at tick 176 to 218 on branch ed307f22 and 196 to 342 on main 2c2955cc) turns its back on the attacker (uid 0). On main the two drop out of contact at tick 62 and the attacker advances into uid 1's ranks, its centre moving from y 484 at tick 70 to 506 or 507 by tick 170. On ed307f22 the side contact (#1845), which leaves out only routing defenders, keeps the attacker in contact at uid 1's rear rank: on the clip seed its centre stays within y 481 to 487 from tick 56 to 170 and is at 481.5 at tick 170. So uid 2 first meets the attacker at tick 168 to 170 on ed307f22 against 146 to 148 on main. Its facing, read to 0.01 in the dump, steps by about 0.6 degrees at a time on both trees; on ed307f22's clip seed the steps reverse five times from tick 86 to 140. Measured 2026-10-22 with 2-tick samples from tick 2 (threshold 3): uid 2 reads, on the clip seed and perturbed seeds 1, 2, 3 and 4, 4, 3, 3, 5 and 6 on ed307f22 (failing on the clip seed and seeds 3 and 4) and 2, 2, 1, 3 and 1 on main 2c2955cc (failing on none); uid 3 reads 7, 8, 10, 8 and 4 on ed307f22 and 5, 6, 2, 6 and 3 on main.
